content.text: The Los Angeles Angels go for their second straight win on Sunday afternoon when they play the Seattle Mariners. The Los Angeles Angels wrap up their three-game series with the Seattle Mariners on Sunday afternoon. They lost the first game of the series 3-1, but snapped a two-game losing streak with a 1-0 win on Saturday. Zach Neto hit a first inning home run for the only run of the game and Jo Adell robbed three home runs to help the Angels even the series on Saturday. The Angels will turn to Ryan Johnson on Sunday in the series finale. Johnson did not pitch well in his first start of the season. He gave up six runs on seven hits in just 3.1 innings against the Chicago Cubs. On Sunday, he is looking to be much better.
